requirement.summary: TMS2.0 - Online booking language switcher missing when the site has no config zone
requirement.description:
Email/ ZOHO Title:

TMS2.0 - Online booking language switcher missing when the site has no config zone

Use Case:

Guest opens TMS online booking. The language switcher and shared media path should still work when the site does not use enterprise config zones, or the outlet/shop has no config zone assigned.

Steps to Reproduce:

Open online booking on a site without enterprise config zones>Open the booking form (classic theme)>Click the language switcher

Current Result:

The language switcher has no language list (classic theme may show a broken icon). Shared media URL is also empty on the new theme. [Unexpected]

Expected Result:

The language switcher still shows the system languages. Shared media URL still follows the system shared data URL. [Expected]

Root Cause [Optional]:

When the outlet or shop has no config zone, the booking page skips loading the system language list and shared data URL, so the language switcher has nothing to show.

Bug Fixing: [Jira-68944] TMS2.0 - Online booking language switcher missing when the site has no config zone
Descriptions:
Fixed an issue where the language switcher icon was not displayed on TMS 2.0 online booking pages when the outlet's shop had no config zone assigned.
Previously, when no config zone was available, the system skipped loading booking language settings and the language dropdown was not rendered on the online booking page.
The system now loads booking language settings without requiring a config zone, and falls back to default booking languages when no config-zone-specific languages are configured.
Affected flow: TMS 2.0 online booking pages that include a language switcher in the theme layout.
Setup:
Before
Open the TMS 2.0 online booking page for an outlet whose shop has no config zone configured.
The language switcher icon is not shown on the booking page.
After
Open the same TMS 2.0 online booking URL after applying this fix.
Verify the language switcher icon is displayed on the booking page.
Select another language from the switcher and confirm the page reloads in the selected language.

requirement.summary: TMS 2.0 - Payment method export/edit leaks password, client_secret and keys
requirement.description:
Problem:

Payment Methods admin export downloaded the full paym_settings JSON, including Shiji password, Payby client_secret, and SilverStone/Astral key. Export also skipped the payment-method read ACL. Edit put those secrets into HTML (client_secret as a text field). View showed Payby client_secret and SilverStone key in plaintext.

Fix:

PaymentMethodsController::admin_export now checks payment-method read access and strips password / client_secret / key from exported JSON. Edit no longer sends stored secrets to the browser (password inputs stay empty; save keeps the DB value if the field is blank). Payby client_secret is a password field. View masks Payby client_secret and SilverStone key.

After fix:

Exported JSON does not include credentials. Import onto an existing method keeps stored secrets if those fields are empty; a new method still requires secrets to be entered.
